title: Transition action of the decrement machine
statement: For any natural number $k$, any work-tape index $i  in k$, any phase $q$ of the machine, any optional Boolean input symbol, and any assignment of an optional Boolean symbol to each work tape, the decrement machine's transition action leaves the input head stationary, and on every work tape its write instruction is never the instruction to write a blank.
hypotheses_covered: A function assigning an optional Boolean symbol to each work tape
